EC1: Confirmed allergy to apatinin [OR] and or its excipients;
EC2: Hypertension (high blood pressure) that can [NOT] not be controlled by drugs;
EC3: A history of active hemorragge [OR], ulcer [OR], intestinal perforation [OR], intestinal obstruction [OR], or major surgery no older than 30 days;
EC4: NYHA [AND] III-IV heart function [OR], or severe hepatic or renal insufficiency (Grade 4);
EC5: Presence of multiple factors that affect oral medications, such as difficulty swallowing [OR], nausea [OR], vomiting [OR], chronic diarrhea [OR] and intestinal obstruction;
EC6: Pregnant or lactating women, or women of child-bearing potential who have planned a pregnancy, or male and female patients who do not agree to practice adequate contraception during this study;
EC7: Patients who have a history of psychotropics [AND] abuse [OR] and can not quit, or who have mental disorders;
EC8: Participation in other drug clinical trial within the last 4 weeks;
EC9: Prior therapy with VEGFR inhibitors such as sorafenib [OR] and sunitinib;
EC10: Presence of comorbidities that seriously affect the patient's safety or ability to complete the study, in the investigator's judgment;
EC11: Patients who can [NOT] not tolerate [AND] apatinib treatment as judged by the investigator depending on the their medical history;
EC12: Patients that are considered ineligible for this study by the investigator.
